description: This Dart file defines a BudgetService class that provides CRUD operations for budget data, interfacing with an API client and managing BudgetModel instances.

classes.name: BudgetService
classes.description: A service class for performing CRUD operations on budgets via an API.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of budgets, optionally filtered by month.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new budget entry based on the provided BudgetModel.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing budget identified by its ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a budget entry identified by its ID.
